add_format_prompt: add model-specific prompt formatting using add_format with a prompt, model, and model name
get_lf_context_settings: get a LangFun context manager with temperature and max_tokens settings
get_lf_context_temperature: get a LangFun context manager with only temperature setting
get_lf_context_max_tokens: get a LangFun context manager with only max_tokens setting
get_lf_context_default: get a LangFun context manager with no settings to use defaults
